grounding.name: multi_hop_grounding_and_retrieved_injection
grounding.question: Trace what happens to a document from the moment a connector discovers it until it is servable, citing each stage.
passages: Connector discovery records version metadata for each remote document before any body is transferred, so admission can compare revisions without downloading full content.
Once a version is admitted, the ingestion pipeline fetches the full content, parses it into structural elements, and chunking packs those elements into canonical chunks.
Chunks are projected into vector embeddings and graph records, and publication moves the active version pointer only after the manifest verifies.
